notes: CDER API/intermediate-manufacturer CGMP letter (equipment cleaning failures, an unresolved particulate complaint, torn/duplicated batch records, non-contemporaneous documentation) citing FDA's data-integrity guidance explicitly. All intermediate/API and equipment identities are redacted as (b)(4), so no product is named in clear. location_contains drops the intervening mandal/district administrative layers, keeping the smallest named locality plus the state as written in the inspection sentence, consistent with how other Indian-facility letters in this corpus are handled (e.g. 'Indrad, Gujarat' from 'Indrad, Dist. Mehsana, Gujarat'). contamination_present is true because an actual unresolved particulate complaint in an intermediate batch is described, not merely a risk.
